body:
**CI: `Snapshot the board to the archive branch` is red on this PR, and it is not this PR's.** Standing down on it; nothing here is being fixed by a push.

- **What fails:** the `pull_request` leg of `board-snapshot.yml` (it runs because this PR touches `scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs`, one of its `paths:`). Under its PR arguments (`--out=board --dry-run --limit=5 --max-requests=25`) the tool exits 2: `count check SHORTFALL of 118 — the archive holds 0 open issue(s) where the board reports 118`, after reading 5 numbers of the history walk of a fresh archive ([run 39804623899](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/actions/runs/39804623899) on `c5c1735`, same on `56b333e`).
- **Why it is not this PR's:** the same command on `origin/main` (`80ec71dc26`, this PR's diff absent) exits 2 with the identical shortfall — reproduced locally with `PM_SWEEP_REPO=objectstack-ai/objectstack node scripts/pm/board-snapshot.mjs --out=/tmp/board --dry-run --limit=5 --max-requests=25`. The scheduled runs on `main` have exited 2 on the count check five times in a row since 2026-10-21 (latest [39795166014](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/actions/runs/39795166014)). `board-snapshot.mjs` imports only `EXIT_PREREQUISITE_NOT_MET`, `PROXY_FLAG`, `labelNames`, `proxyRearmPlan` and `resolveSweepRepo` from `check-half-states.mjs`; none of those changes in this diff (it adds `LANE_LABEL_ALIASES` / `canonicalLane` after `labelNames` and routes the lane comparisons through them).
- **Fix ported:** none exists yet that I know of — the count-check failure of the scheduled leg is tracked on #24351 (open, `pm:awaiting-maintainer`), and no PR is open against it. A fresh dry-run archive under `--limit` can never hold the board's open count, so the PR leg fails by construction on today's `main`; that is the tool's (or the workflow's PR-mode arguments') to repair, in its own card, not this PR's.
- **Re-run:** not spent — the failure is deterministic (reproduced on `main`'s own code), so a re-run would only repeat it.

Also seen: `TypeScript Type Check` red on `56b333e` is the aggregator reading two lanes as `cancelled` because the push of `c5c1735` superseded that run ([39804119528](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/actions/runs/39804119528), run conclusion `cancelled`); the run on `c5c1735` is the one that counts.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `c5c17359be5db4bd08a06b228f8550df204b3faa`
Local-runs: none
Scope: .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/cli.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/engine.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/server.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/services.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/spec.md + scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs (LANE_LABEL_ALIASES / canonicalLane and every lane comparison it feeds: seatLane, newestLaneClaim, censusLanesOf, the H32 inventory, the H38 fixtures and the new battery), scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs (CEILINGS, CROSS_FILE_MOVES platform-readings sources, MAX_TABLE_ROW_BYTES), scripts/pm/ensure-pm-labels.sh (domain-lane block, header rule), .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/devx.md (read, unchanged: its scope defers to the SKILL.md row), .github/workflows/board-snapshot.yml on main (the red check's PR leg), packages/plugins, packages/drivers, packages/services, packages/connectors (tree listing on the head, for the union-scope check)

Inputs: card #24907 body and all four comments (binding ruling 6341410910, letter 乙; dev report 6344765480), PR #25247 body, file list (9 paths) and the net diff `origin/main...c5c1735` (merge-base `80ec71dc26`), the 50 check-runs on the head, the annotations API of the one red job and of main's own run of the same workflow. Not read: the dispatch order or the seat's conclusions.

### ① Derived judgments

1. **No Tier H path touched — right.** The committed file list is 6 paths under `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/**` and 3 under `scripts/pm/**`. AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, docs/NORTH-STAR.md, `skills/**`, `.github/workflows/**`, CODEOWNERS: absent. Governed-path face ⇒ this tier; the Governed Surface Queue Guard check is green.
2. **SKILL.md lane table: the `domain:server` row is the exact union of the three old rows — right.** Old engine ∪ services ∪ cli = objectql, core, formula, plugin-pinyin-search, metadata*, platform-objects, drivers/driver-*, services/*, connectors/*, triggers/*, plugin-approvals/webhooks/email/reports, embedder-openai, knowledge-*, plugin-auth/security/sharing/audit, cli, runtime, verify, **qa**, types, rest, mcp, observability, client*, cloud-connection, create-objectstack, adapters/*, plugin-hono-server, plugin-dev. New row names every one of these except `qa`, which moves to the devx row (judgment 3). The one generalisation, `plugin-*`, was checked against the tree at the head: `packages/plugins/` holds exactly the ten `plugin-*` packages the three old rows named and nothing else that matches (`organizations`, `knowledge-memory`, `knowledge-ragflow`, `embedder-openai` are covered by their own spellings or were never in these rows), so `plugin-*` widens nothing. `drivers/*` ≡ `packages/drivers/driver-*` on the tree (five driver-* dirs, nothing else). No other row of the table named a plugin, so no package changes lane except `packages/qa`.
3. **`packages/qa` → `domain:devx` — right.** Present in the devx row, absent from the server row, and `lanes/server.md` CLI section says 「`packages/qa` 已归 `domain:devx`」. `lanes/devx.md` needs no edit: its 范围 says the path face lives in the SKILL.md row only (⛔ 不另抄).
4. **Retired-label rule — right, with a disclosed loss of four names.** The new bullet 「退役 `domain:*` 只退流通,对象保留;`domain:engine`/`domain:services`/`domain:cli` 读作 `domain:server`」 keeps the generic rule the two old rows carried and adds the alias reading the ruling orders. The per-name list `engine-core / metadata / drivers / identity` leaves SKILL.md; its home is the header of `ensure-pm-labels.sh` (lines 42–50 on the head), and no script or gate anchors on SKILL.md naming them (grepped `scripts/**` and the skill tree at the head). Accept-set unchanged.
5. **The three charters → `lanes/server.md`: nothing silently lost — right.** Word-level diff of engine.md + services.md + cli.md (main) against server.md (head) shows every bullet verbatim except: (a) the two duplicate 「见 seat-lifecycle.md…」 preambles deduplicated to one; (b) three heading levels (## → ###) and three section headings naming the former lanes; (c) the three per-lane spec red lines (engine 「改元数据格式或接受面 ⇒ domain:spec,判据是改变接受面而不是碰到 spec」, services 「零持有 packages/spec」, cli 「packages/spec 恒归 spec 座位」) consolidated into one lane-wide line 「触 packages/spec 的卡一律归 spec 席;改元数据格式或接受面的卡亦然,不论碰没碰 spec」; (d) engine's two pointers to `domain:cli` and `domain:services` removed — both targets are now sections of the same file (the `/meta` rule survives in the CLI section, `packages/services/**` in the services scope); (e) `qa` dropped from the CLI scope with the devx pointer added; (f) 「本车道/本席」 → 「本节」 twice. Section bullet counts match the old files one to one (engine 9 席内判断, services 4, cli 5, 常设承诺 2/4/5). The consolidation (c) is the union of the three red lines, which on the engine surface is a tightening: a card that touches `packages/spec` without changing the accept set now goes to the spec seat where engine.md's clause did not require it. That is consistent with the table (`domain:spec` = `packages/spec` 整包) and with the other two charters, and the PR body discloses it; named here so the engine-surface seat reads it as a change, not a carry-over. Judged right.
6. **The read-one-section rule — right.** 「三节按文件面分读:认领的 `File surface:` 落在哪节就读哪节,⛔ 不读整篇」 is what the ruling's point 2 asked for.
7. **`lanes/spec.md` pointer — right.** `/meta` 路由本体 now names `domain:server`; 「归 domain:spec」 → 「归本席」 on spec's own charter is a no-op in meaning. 42 → 42 lines; no other skill file points at `lanes/engine.md`, `lanes/services.md` or `lanes/cli.md` on the head (grepped).
8. **Ratchet ledger: only lowered ceilings and rows moved by measured lengths — right.** SKILL.md ceiling 319 → 317 = the head's landed count (main is 318 after #25240; the diff is −1 net: 3 rows out, 1 row + 1 bullet in). Widest-row pin 342 → 341 = the measured widest row on the head (the server row; next widest 339). engine 32 / services 27 / cli 29 rows deleted, `lanes/server.md` 87 added = its landed count (88 summed → 87). MAX_TABLE_ROW_BYTES rows follow the files (three out, server.md 0 in). No line in SKILL.md or the charters was re-wrapped to buy a line: the only edited SKILL.md lines are the table rows themselves and the new bullet.
9. **CROSS_FILE_MOVES platform-readings sources: cli.md 35 + services.md 30 → server.md 97 — right.** `crossFileMoveVerdict` refuses a source that carries no ceiling, so the two deleted paths had to be replaced. `was` 97 = 35 + 30 + 32 (engine.md's ceiling at the merge): engine's lines enter `was` and the current ceiling alike, so they add nothing to the credited decrease; the credited decrease moves 9 → 10, the one extra line being what the merge itself deleted from the three sources, which under this arithmetic (pre-move ceiling minus current ceiling, the same reading the 2026-09-04 rewrite's reductions already got) is a genuine source deletion. The dev's claim 「what the merge itself deleted is counted once, here」 is correct. Dest ceiling 460 unchanged.
10. **`check-half-states.mjs` aliases — right, and complete for this file.** `LANE_LABEL_ALIASES` is frozen, names exactly the three retired labels, and `canonicalLane` passes everything else through. Every non-test lane comparison in the file goes through it: `seatLane` (seat title), `newestLaneClaim` (both the wanted lane and each card label), `censusLanesOf` and the H32 inventory in `sweepInto` (both deduplicated). The only other `domain:` reader outside self-tests is the 「has any domain label」 test at line 3689, which the alias does not affect. H38 at line 23000–23006 reads lane and seat from `seatLane`, so it is covered.
11. **Alias not in `check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs` / `clause2-line.mjs` — right.** Grepped at the head: the ratchet names the three lanes only in ledger comments; `clause2-line.mjs` once, in a JSDoc example. Neither reads a label. The card's point 4 premise was wrong about those two files, and the dev measured it rather than inventing a reader; no other `scripts/pm/**` file compares the three labels in non-test code (`check-merge-queue-triage-outcome.mjs`, `osv-base-relative.mjs` hits are fixtures).
12. **Self-tests — right.** Battery `domain:server lane aliases` registered on the frozen roster (pin 22, 24 cases incl. pass-through, both-direction claim index, one-lane-not-two census), roster floor 9 → 10 with every floor assertion (BATTERY19129, 18901, 18664, 19255, 67, 68) moved in step. The three H38 expectations re-keyed from `domain:services` to `domain:server` are the direct consequence of the alias on a fixture titled with the old spelling; the fixture itself is unchanged, and the 「no dispatched cards」 control moved to `domain:skills` because `domain:engine` is now the same lane as the fixture's cards (it would have been found). The `Lint · scoped · tooling self-tests` and `Live half-state sweep` checks are green on the head.
13. **`ensure-pm-labels.sh` — right.** `domain:server` created with the lane description; `domain:engine/services/cli` keep a create line each so the reconcile shim (which re-sends every create line's `-d` as an edit) writes the 「Retired 2026-10-22, alias of domain:server …」 description onto the live objects — 100 / 99 / 97 characters, under the cap (`check:pm-label-desc-cap` is inside the green repo & tooling lane). The header's retired-lanes-are-absent rule records them as the one transitional exception. No objectui or hotcrm block names the three lanes.
14. **Check-runs on the head: 37 success, 13 skipped, 1 failure.** The failure is `Snapshot the board to the archive branch` (job 119914412539), the `pull_request` leg of `board-snapshot.yml` (triggered by its `paths:` entry for `scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs`). Signature read from the API, not from prose: failing step 「Fail the run if the snapshot did not read the board, or the archive is behind it」, first error annotation 「board-snapshot exited 2 — 2 is a failed count check (the archive and the board disagree about how many open issues exist) …」. The merge-base commit `80ec71dc26` carries no run of this job (the leg is pull_request-only on PRs; main runs it on schedule), so the base signature was read off main's latest scheduled run 39795166014 at `f2ade4afb0`, an ancestor of the merge-base with `board-snapshot.mjs` and the workflow unchanged between them: same failing step, same first error line, and the four latest scheduled runs on main are all red. Same-signature red at the base ⇒ not counted against this head. The tool's own self-test step passed on the head. This PR changes none of the five symbols `board-snapshot.mjs` imports from `check-half-states.mjs`. The main-red card exists (#24351). Everything else is green, including every Type Check and Lint lane, Test Core 1–6, both queue guards, the dispatch-gates lane and the live half-state sweep.

### ② Semver level

No changeset, `skip-changeset` label — **matches the diff.** The nine paths are `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/**` and `scripts/pm/**`; no `packages/**`, no `exports`, no `.d.ts`, no published schema. `Clause-②: no` on the PR body (line-initial, with `Metadata-protocol: none`) — **right**: no accept set is relaxed and no public surface grows. The one widening in the diff is the sweep's lane comparison (three spellings read as one lane), which is PM tooling behaviour, not a published contract, and is floored by its own battery.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **Dev flag: alias only in `check-half-states.mjs`.** Answered — verified at the head (judgment 11). The card's point 4 premise was wrong about the ratchet and clause2-line; the deviation is correct, and the ruling's intent (every reader that compares the labels sees every card) is met by the one reader that exists.
- **Dev flag: SKILL.md no longer names `engine-core / metadata / drivers / identity`.** Answered — the names survive in the `ensure-pm-labels.sh` header, nothing anchors on SKILL.md for them, and the generic 只退流通,对象保留 rule stays (judgment 4). Not a loss of rule.
- **Dev flag: three H38 expectations re-keyed to the merged spelling.** Answered — a consequence of the alias on fixtures titled with a retired spelling; the specimen is unchanged and the controls moved for the stated reason (judgment 12).
- **`open_questions`: [] on the dev report.** Nothing to answer.
- **Found by this review, not flagged by the dev — not blocking, named for the seat and the next round:**
  1. The devx row was trimmed beyond the `packages/qa` insertion to keep the width pin: `content/docs/**` → `content/docs`, `docs/qa/**` → `docs/qa`, `.githooks/` → `.githooks`, `scripts/` → `scripts`, `.github/workflows/` → `.github/workflows`, and 「按锚定规则例外归」 → 「按锚定规则归」. Meaning preserved (bare prefixes are the table's own convention — `apps/docs`, `packages/qa` — and the three still route to `domain:spec`), no script parses the row's globs, but the PR body does not disclose it. Undisclosed editing of governed text, even neutral, is the kind of thing this review exists to catch; here the text is judged equivalent, so it stays a note.
  2. Transitional H38 noise: until the former engine/services/cli seat-1 posts are retitled (ruling point 5), `seatLane` reads them all as `domain:server` seat 1, and `newestLaneClaim` will hand each of them the newest seat-1 claim of the merged lane, so a claim by one former lane's seat 1 can read as 「post stale」 on another's. H38 is a report row, not a gate; it clears as each seat retitles at its next round. Named so the seats do not chase it.
  3. The red `Snapshot the board` check is main's own signature (judgment 14). Whether this head may be queued carrying it is the dispatching seat's call under SKILL.md 205–206 and the 主干红止血 rule; the standing-down comment 6344588150 on the PR names gate and cause, and #24351 is the card.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `d062675f2edb243ac0691141a5e44a89dac97f36`
Local-runs: none
Scope: .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/cli.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/engine.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/server.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/services.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/spec.md + scripts/pm/board-snapshot.mjs (the whole file at the head: the new header section, `BLANK_PAGE_ASKS` / `blankPageStep`, the `walk` closure, `countCheckPendingReason` / `countCheck` / `freshnessCheck` / `materialManifest`, the manifest assembly and `resume` block, `renderRun` and its exit code, `rest` / `makeBudget` / `readBoardArithmetic`, `selectWalkPlan` / `selectDeltaPlan`, `fakeBoard` and the new battery), .github/workflows/board-snapshot.yml (read, unchanged: `pull_request` paths and arguments, steps 4 / 6 / 10), package.json `check:pm-board-snapshot` (unchanged), scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs, scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs, scripts/pm/ensure-pm-labels.sh (carried from the prior record, unchanged between the two heads)

Inputs: card #24907 body and all four comments (ruling 6341410910; dev report 6344765480); card #24351 body and its three comments; PR #25247 body as rewritten (the CI-fix paragraph), its file list (10 paths), the net diff `origin/main...d062675` and the one-commit diff `c5c1735..d062675`, both PR comments (6344588150, and the prior record 6344994978 on head `c5c1735`); the 42 check-runs on this head, the Board Snapshot workflow runs on this head, the prior head and `main`, and the annotations of the red jobs. Not read: the dispatch order, the seat's conclusions, job logs (blob redirect, unreadable from here).

### ① Derived judgments

1. **The governed hits are byte-identical between the two heads — the prior record's judgments 1–13 carry.** Blob ids at `c5c1735` and `d062675`: SKILL.md `15cf1084`, lanes/server.md `91c42c37`, lanes/spec.md `23c92d54`, and lanes/{engine,services,cli}.md absent at both. `check-half-states.mjs`, `check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs` and `ensure-pm-labels.sh` are not in the one-commit diff either. The one commit between the heads touches `scripts/pm/board-snapshot.mjs` alone (+146/−4). Still no Tier H path: `.github/workflows/board-snapshot.yml` has blob `81c0824d` at both heads and is not in the file list; AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, NORTH-STAR, `skills/**`, CODEOWNERS absent. Governed Surface Queue Guard is green on this head.
2. **The diagnosis matches the code the fix replaces — right.** At the prior head a `200 []` first page went straight to `nextWalkStep({batchLength: 0})`, which is `done` on any short page; the open walk returned true at zero records, `openSetCompletedHere` made `countCheckPendingReason` return null, `readBoardArithmetic` read 118, the history walk read 5 numbers to the `--limit`, and `countCheck` reported a shortfall of 118 → exit 2. That is the exact line the standing-down comment quotes from the prior head's job and the signature the prior head's annotation carries (step 10, `board-snapshot exited 2`). The upstream measurement (39 of 68 probes blank) is the dev's own and was not re-run here; the code reading does not depend on it.
3. **`blankPageStep` — right, and pure.** Below the bound: ask again. At the bound: stop iff the page is the first page of an un-anchored walk (`since === null && page === 1`) and the witness is not zero (null = unknown counts as not zero, so an unread or unreadable witness stops rather than believes); otherwise believe. The witness is `/repos/{repo}.open_issues_count`, which counts issues and pull requests together — the same population the `/issues` listing serves — so a non-zero witness is exactly the fact that a blank `state=open` first page contradicts.
4. **The walk — right.** A re-ask is the same URL (`since` and `page` untouched, `listingPath` fixes `per_page`), every ask passes `walkBudget.spend()` first, and nothing sleeps: the loop is bounded by the constant and by the budget, and in a delta slice `SliceExhausted` is caught by the existing delta boundary. The witness read also spends the budget, once per walk, only when the first page of an un-anchored walk is blank. `blankAsks` resets on a non-blank page, so the bound is per page. A stop sets `stopped = {kind: 'blank-listing'}` and returns false: the caller leaves `openSetComplete`, `historyComplete` and `walkComplete` as they were; the `!stopped` guards skip `readBoardArithmetic`; `countCheckPendingReason` returns the count-not-read reason; `countCheck` returns `pending` with `ok: null`; the manifest's `resume` carries the walk's own unmoved cursor and `stopped_by: 'blank-listing'`; `renderRun`'s exit is `EXIT_OK` (not rate-limit, `check.ok === false` is false, not stale). The `'blank-listing'` branch in `renderRun` is placed before the generic `else if (result.stopped)` so it is reachable. A non-array 200 body (`Array.isArray(batch) ? batch : []`) now goes through the same re-ask instead of being a short page — a strict improvement.
5. **Not a silent pass — with the exposure named precisely.** (a) The from-the-beginning stop marks nothing complete, so no verdict can be `ok`. (b) A blank believed past an anchor is `done` with `since: lastUpdatedAt ?? since` = the anchor itself, so the cursor does not move (`next_since` in the incremental phase, the delta cursor in the history phase; the battery asserts `next_since` unchanged); and because `walkCompletedHere` / `deltaCompletedHere` is then true, the count check still runs against the board's own count, so a believed blank that hid real open/close movement reads SHORTFALL or SURPLUS, exit 2 — a red, not a pass. The residual: a blank believed past an anchor whose missed rows do not move the net open count (edits, comments, a close paired with an open) reads `ok` / `fresh` for that one run; the cursor is unmoved and the next run re-reads. Before this commit one blank was believed on sight; now six consecutive are needed. At the measured 57 % blank rate, six independent blanks are about 3.5 % per anchored page per run — named in ③, not a defect.
6. **The freshness claim — right where the open set is complete, overstated where it is not.** `freshnessCheck` ages a `pending` streak only after `openSetComplete`; while the open set is incomplete it returns `building` with no `pending_since` and never turns red — the tool's pre-existing semantics for an archive still being built, not something this commit changed. So: a `blank-listing` stop in the history walk's first page (open set complete, history cursor null) or any believed blank that leaves the check pending opens or carries the streak and exits 5 after 24 h — the PR body's claim holds there. A `blank-listing` stop in the OPEN walk from the beginning — a fresh archive, which is the PR leg (`--dry-run --limit=5`), or a scheduled archive that is back in the open phase — exits 0 as `building` on every run for as long as the listing blanks, and nothing ages. On the PR leg that is the intended smoke semantics (the `--limit` stop already exits 0 pending). On the scheduled leg it matters only if `main`'s archive is in the open phase; that could not be read from the annotations (exit 2 only) and the job logs are unreadable here. Flagged in ③ for the PR body, not a FAIL: nothing is marked complete, the open-set line prints INCOMPLETE, the count check prints PENDING, and the never-aged `building` state predates this commit.
7. **A witness of zero believes a blank `state=all` first page too — note.** `blankPageStep` does not know the walk's `state`: on a board with zero open items but a closed history, the history walk's first page (un-anchored) blanking six times would be believed and the history marked complete at zero closed records. Impossible on this board (118 open) and not reachable by the PR leg; named so the next edit of this rule carries the state.
8. **The battery — right.** 13 `t(` calls under `battery('the blank page: …')`, matching the roster entry `13` and the floor `12 → 13`; every floor assertion that names the count is the roster itself. The cases assert what the code does: the seven pure verdicts of judgment 3; the healed case (`blankListings: 1`) with `complete === true`, `issues_open === 3`, `count_check.verdict === 'ok'`, `blank_pages_reasked === 1`; call order listing → `/repos/o/r` → the same listing URL with `per_page=100` (matches the walk: witness read before the verdict); the always-blank board stops with `walk.open_set.complete === false`, `count_check.verdict === 'pending'`, `resume.stopped_by === 'blank-listing'`, `resume.phase === 'open'`, exactly `BLANK_PAGE_ASKS` listing requests plus one witness (`requests === 7`), `exitCode === EXIT_OK` with the STOPPED line; and the anchored case on a built archive completes the incremental walk with `blank_pages_reasked === 5` and `next_since` equal to the unblanked run's. `fakeBoard`'s blank counter applies to the issues listing only — never `/repos/o/r` or the pulls — which is the measured shape.
9. **Manifest hygiene — right.** `run.blank_pages_reasked` sits in the `run` block, which `materialManifest` strips, so a counter that moves every run cannot commit a manifest-only diff on the archive branch; the summary prints it only when non-zero.
10. **Workflow and gate — unchanged, and the gate verdict is green on this head.** `board-snapshot.yml` triggers its `pull_request` leg on `scripts/pm/board-snapshot.mjs` (paths), so the leg ran on this head: run 39816905983, job 119957650821 success — step 4 `The tool's own cases` success (the `--self-test` behind `pnpm check:pm-board-snapshot`), step 6 `Run the snapshot` success, step 10 skipped (exit 0). On the prior head the same job (119914412539) failed at step 10 with the exit-2 annotation, and `main`'s latest scheduled run 39795166014 (job 119880551843) carries the identical signature; `main`'s eight latest scheduled runs are all red. The red is gone on this head by the change, not by a re-run. `Lint · scoped · tooling self-tests` is green too.
11. **Check-runs on this head: 42 — 33 success, 9 skipped, 0 failure.** Every Type Check and Lint lane, Test Core 1–6 and the aggregator, Governed Surface Queue Guard, both claim guards, `Part-of PR must not also close its card`, `The card this PR closes must claim this branch`, Live half-state sweep, PM dispatch-gates, Dogfood Regression Gate: success.
